name: Ved'my
source:
Eric, an ordinary man who has always laughed at tales about witches, finds himself in the center of the witches' magical world. He gets to meet the witches, get to know them from a different side and in different poses.

Eric wakes up in a mysterious house, imprisoned by two powerful and witches who plan to eat him. Eric is surrounded by unknown forces, ancient spells and mystical creatures, and rescue seems like a pipe dream in this desperate situation. The surrounding area is desolate, and help is not coming. So, Eric decides to meet his fate face to face, learn more about his captors, study their characters and capabilities, and he also wants to fuck them, because they are so sexy!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
向来对女巫传说嗤之以鼻的普通男子埃里克，某天竟意外置身于女巫魔法世界的中心。他将与女巫们正面相遇，从截然不同的一面——乃至以各种各样的体位——深入了解她们。

埃里克在一栋神秘屋舍中醒来，发现自己被两位法力高强的女巫囚禁，而对方正盘算着要把他吃掉。四周尽是未知的力量、古老的咒语与诡秘的生物，身陷绝境的他深知获救无异于痴人说梦；屋外荒无人烟，援兵更不可能到来。于是，埃里克决定直面命运，进一步了解囚禁自己的女巫，摸清她们的性格与本领——顺便还想把她们睡个痛快，谁叫她们性感得要命呢！
